calls.title: Statsig demo
calls.summary: Statsig has transitioned from a pure experimentation focus to a comprehensive product building platform, enhancing its offerings to include integrated analytics and metrics tracking, driven by competitive pressures from Amplitude. The platform now features customizable dashboards for metrics exploration, automated data collection for quick dashboard setups, and safe rollouts with monitoring safeguards to detect regressions during gradual feature releases. The collaborative capabilities of experiment dashboards encourage team discussions and informed decision-making. Emphasizing proactive monitoring, Statsig integrates alerts for metrics, ensuring quick identification of issues and supporting a reliable experimentation culture.
calls.keywords: Statsig, feature gating, experimentation, data warehouse, metric alerting, progressive disclosure
